name: montology
description: A repo's vocabulary as a database, enforced against the code by a tree-sitter scan in every language it declares — Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Swift, Java, Ruby, Elixir, C/C++. Check a name before declaring it, mine the words a codebase is already asking for, propagate a rename by token, and inherit one org ontology across every repo. Design tokens are one kind of word among many.
